gallery.selection: lexicographically first complete matching-source gallery path

rules.E: Most negative conservative global delta lower = candidate global lower - matched global upper
rules.I: Largest positive conservative delta upper = candidate upper - matched lower
rules.S: Largest positive nominal delta; most negative nominal delta; nearest to the median over every numeric pair. Delta intervals accompany all selections.
rules.missing: NA is retained, never replaced by0/1; all16 registered paired rows remain delivered
rules.multiple_categories: One case may legitimately occur in multiple categories. No replacement to increase apparent diversity.
rules.selection_is_not: Not a success decision, checkpoint choice, generalization claim, or human usability study
rules.ties: retain all ties; lexicographic request_id is display first
rules.visual: Explicit actual AI_VISUAL_REVIEW WORSE for these exact model labels and request; conservative S increase, or S lower delta>=-.005 and conservative I reduction or E increase

record.condition_compatibility_observation: Both have an orange raised seat over the blue base. The lower needle is outside most of the known-condition overlay region.
record.feedback_overlay_observation: Mostly red S, mostly gray I, and mainly green E at C do not reveal the hanging free-region needle.
record.geometry_observation: The teacher retains a broad continuous back. TR has a jagged slatted back and a conspicuous long downward needle/sliver under the seat, visible in the side view. The slatted style alone is not judged a defect; the new needle and jagged edges are. The main chair remains recognizable.

record.condition_compatibility_observation: The small fixed blue support/known region does not constrain the large missing and fragmented free body sufficiently to certify usability.
record.feedback_overlay_observation: The known foot/boundary remains red in S; I is mostly gray and E mostly green on the known bar. Those C-local overlays do not compensate for the visible body deterioration.
record.geometry_observation: Clear new main-body deterioration against both the teacher and START: TR loses much of the side/support structure and its seat and under-seat region break into dense narrow strips, gaps, jagged triangles and long protrusions. The teacher is already changed from the START box chair, but retains broad contiguous panels and a more coherent seat/frame. This decision concerns fragmentation and support loss, not an armchair-to-armless style preference.

record.condition_compatibility_observation: The blue known region remains visible; the new interior cracks and base roughness are free-geometry defects.
record.feedback_overlay_observation: S remains red at the known foot patch, with mainly gray I and green E at the known bar. No quantitative superiority is inferred from these sparse condition-local markers.
record.geometry_observation: The teacher and START preserve a coherent box-like chair. TR retains that overall shell but has a more buckled/layered front seat/base, a narrow white crack inside the back, warped upper edges, and ragged lower parts. Local deterioration is visible without the severe body breakup of noise 0.

record.condition_compatibility_observation: The orange seat remains offset above the blue known triangle and the narrow orange leg is visibly separated from the blue leg in some views.
record.feedback_overlay_observation: S is predominantly red along the C leg/seat. Local I markers shift around the seat; E retains a red known-seat patch and green known leg. These observations do not replace the saved numerical classifications.
record.geometry_observation: TR has a more conspicuously raised/floating orange seat and sharp protruding seat triangle, with a larger apparent junction gap by the known leg. An orange leg sliver is pulled away from the blue leg. Some small back holes reduce, but the seat/junction defect is worse. The complete chair silhouette survives.

record.condition_compatibility_observation: Known blue frame remains, but the orange cap and triangular panels fit it irregularly. A solid-versus-slatted style change is not itself the reason for the worse judgment.
record.feedback_overlay_observation: Upper S markers that are partly green in the teacher are largely red in TR; I has local purple/red seat-junction markers. E stays mainly green with localized red.
record.geometry_observation: Against the teacher relatively coherent slatted back/cap, TR has a ragged open triangular crown and a long white diagonal back gap between large orange triangles. A thin split front leg is also visible. Seat, legs and the main back remain present, so this is substantial local deterioration rather than the clear whole-body breakup seen at 341b noise 0.

record.condition_compatibility_observation: The blue back and seat triangle project beyond the orange surfaces. The new long back opening is a local compatibility/continuity concern.
record.feedback_overlay_observation: Known-seat S stays mostly red, with some green along the inner back edge. I markers move near the junction; E remains green with purple unknown markers. Unknown colors are not treated as confirmed failures.
record.geometry_observation: The teacher orange back is mostly continuous with small holes. TR introduces a long conspicuous white vertical slit and additional narrow holes; the seat still has thin gaps and a rough lip. The complete chair body is retained.
